# Roshani Kamble — Blockchain & Web3 Developer

Personal engineering portfolio of Roshani Kamble, a Blockchain & Web3 developer based in Pune, Maharashtra, India.

## What this site offers
- Featured Web3 engineering projects: ChainSentinel (smart-contract security analysis), ChainEscrow (milestone escrow dApp), LendGuard (educational DeFi lending protocol), VerifiChain (blockchain credential verification)
- Detailed case studies covering architecture, on-chain/off-chain design, testing, security and limitations
- Technical stack across Solidity, Ethereum, EVM, React, TypeScript, Ethers.js, Foundry and Hardhat
- Education, achievement and direct contact details
